director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ground ki boundary se perimeter, yaani chaaron taraf ki lambai, dekhenge. Cricket mein tumhe kya pasand hai?
haan
Riya, maine tumhari pasand poochhi thi; “haan” se woh pata nahi chali. Cricket ground ka chakkar lagao toh kaunsi lambai ginni hogi? Baad mein Golu ko sikhaogi.
step by step samjhao
Haan Riya, dheere chalenge. Perimeter matlab boundary ki poori lambai. Iske liye sab sides ki lambai jodte hain. Kya koi side chhodenge?
chhota bolo
Theek hai, Riya, chhota bolungi. Polygon ka perimeter sab sides jodkar milta hai; cricket ground par bhi. Koi side chhootegi?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, cricket ground ki boundary socho: do lengths 50 m, do breadths 30 m. Perimeter kaise jodogi?
pata nahi
Riya, koi baat nahi. Picture mein 50 m wali do sides hain. Un dono ko jodoge toh kitna?
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, thodi der kuch aur baat karte hain; phir is step par lautenge. Kis baare mein?
cricket ke baare mein
Riya, cricket ki baat end mein pakka karenge. Abhi ek round ka perimeter 160 m nikla tha; teen rounds ke liye usse teen baar lena hai. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
hindi mein batao
Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Riya, ek chakkar ki kul lambai 160 meter hai; ab teen chakkaron ki kul lambai nikalo. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
mujhe khud try karne do
Haan Riya, pehle tum koshish karo; madad baad mein. 160 meter ke teen chakkar, kul kitne meter?
bye
Riya, tum abhi rukna chahti ho. Aage badhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj ke liye band karein?
